objective: Determine which Film Damage controls and raster dimensions change the shared random-call schedule before later scratch, flicker and film-burn-center decisions, and quantify the source-level call-count coupling without claiming rendered RNG parity.

scope.effect: FilmDamageCPUImpl shared mt19937 / uniform_real_distribution / normal_distribution call order, excluding per-row grain RNG.
scope.method: Static source markers plus a high-level distribution-call ledger using the exact source integer count formulas and fixed control/dimension matrix. No random engine is executed or emulated.
excluded: actual random values or mark placements

comparison.baseline: Default Dust=.08, Scratches=.10, Seed=1977, Evolution=0 at 512x512. Baseline is a call-ledger reference, not a preferred quality state.
candidates: combined default, zero-damage, and maximum Dust/Scratches cases
comparison.ground_truth: None. This is a source call-graph/count analysis, not visual output comparison.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive source-contract result. Exact integer counts and explicit distribution invocation counts must match source formulas. Do not infer exact engine positions, random values, placements or visible differences.

materials.fixture: No pixel fixture. Conditions are source defaults and selected in-range control/dimension values.
materials.rights: Not applicable; no external or image material.
materials.identity: Record SHA-256 of source, plan and runner; output metrics include every evaluated condition and source marker.

conditions.numeric_domain: Controls are nonnegative Float values in the source clamp ranges. Count model uses truncation toward zero; input products are evaluated as IEEE float32 to reflect source float expressions before integer conversion.
conditions.frame_and_seed: Seed=1977 and Evolution=0 as fixed labels; frameKey affects the base engine seed but not call counts. No engine sequence is generated.
conditions.source_call_schedule: Gate weave requests 2 normal variates; each dust mark requests 5 uniform variates; each scratch requests 5 uniform plus 1 normal variate; Flicker requests 1 normal variate; burn center requests 2 uniform variates. Distribution-internal engine draw counts are implementation-dependent and excluded.
metrics: uniform and normal distribution invocation totals
position in the declared high-level call ledger at Flicker and Burn center
delta from baseline and zero-damage cases
conditions.image_output: No image is generated: no random values are emulated, and synthetic placements would not answer the static call-schedule question.

effect_correctness.method: Verify formulas and loop call sites in FilmDamageEffect.cpp against the ledger; cross-check control clamps and separate rowRng construction.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Source markers all resolve; formula counts match exact truncating float32 computations for every condition. No output parity claim.

image_quality_and_detail.reason: This audit measures random-call coupling, not image appearance; no positions or pixels are generated.

color_and_alpha.reason: No pixel values or alpha are generated.

temporal_stability.method: Compare control/dimension call counts at a fixed seed/frame key. Prior Evolution key audit covers frame quantization separately.
temporal_stability.unverified: Actual per-frame draws, visible flicker and seek/reverse output.

render_paths_and_resolution.method: Compare source count formulas across five raster sizes.
render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Application dispatch, raster dimensions received, preview/final behavior and actual output.

performance.reason: Call counts are not runtime timings or allocation measurements.

execution.backend: Python 3 static source analysis; no C++/app execution.
execution.threshold_policy: Source counts are exact under the stated float32/truncation model; quality thresholds are not applicable.
execution.reproducibility: Record Python version, input hashes, source markers, condition matrix and generated artifact hashes.
